name: @ever-works/bluesky-connector-plugin
description: Bluesky social connector plugin for Ever Works platform (outbound posts via the official @atproto/api SDK, and event-source pull of mentions/replies plus the account's own timeline into the event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill)

plugin.name: Bluesky Connector
plugin.description: Bluesky (AT Protocol) social connector. Outbound publishes posts and threaded replies via the official @atproto/api SDK. Event-source pull ingests mentions/replies and the connected account's own posts since the last watermark into the platform event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill (backfillDays, max 90).

appPassword.title: Bluesky app password (never your account password)

backfillDays.title: Historical backfill window in days on first pull (0 = off, max 90)
